A printing fix.

### What's changed
- **Cards fill the page edge to edge.** Some printer drivers, such as PDF printers, adjust the card size slightly (a PDF printer makes a CR80 card 55 × 85 mm). The card was drawn at the size asked for, which left a thin strip down one side and trimmed the bottom. The card now fills the paper the driver really uses.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients and people.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.10 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.10.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
